edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Ordinary human address is you to the lady, with you all marking the plural audience in 1:6 and 1:12. Modern verbs and to replace the older register. Chosen lady/children and chosen sister are retained without deciding personal versus ecclesial identity. Truth/love, commandment/walking and abiding repetitions remain. Coming in flesh in 1:7 is not converted to a completed participle. You must not lose what we have worked for (1:8) keeps the pronoun distinction. Our joy in 1:12 follows the consulted NA28; no final Amen is added.
chapters.focus: Read all 13 Greek and English verses, focusing on singular/plural address, the future assurance with us in 1:3, coming in flesh, you/we in 1:8, teaching in 1:9–11 and our joy in 1:12.
chapters.running_text_read: Displayed NA28 running text read; focused comparison of the recorded features, not an exhaustive apparatus collation.
chapters.pending: Review the identity of the lady/sister, the teaching-of-Christ genitive and the practical scope of reception/greeting in 1:10–11. Face to face renders the literal mouth to mouth idiom in 1:12; the literal expression is preserved in notes. Full UBS6/ECM and apparatus comparison, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
